summary_1line: Krishna consoles grieving Yudhishthira, recounting Indra’s battle with Vritra and teaching that inner enemies and imbalance of mind and body cause suffering.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna speaks gently to a despondent Yudhishthira who sits with head bowed, like a sun darkened by eclipse.
Indra hurls his thunderbolt at the serpent Vritra who coils around the world, draining the elements of their properties.
The sage Samvarta stands blazing like fire on the sacrificial altar, offering clarified butter while the gods gather to drink Soma.
